name: 34234 · Sarasota, FL
findings: ZIP 34234 (Sarasota) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34234 (Sarasota) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
